name: WinterBear
identity: White shaggy bear with dark brown stripes and ochre patches, stern white eyes, broad golden muzzle, four heavy clawed paws and short fur tail.
specific_constraints: Exactly four bear paws, no wings, horns or long canine tail
Up head shows only white-gray outer ear backs and shaggy rear skull; no facial markings
Short pointed furry tail, white-gray with ochre patch, matches original atlas
Body must remain low quadruped, gray shaded white with broad dark brown stripes and ochre spots
Fore/hind root centers opaque and overlapped inside shoulder/hip
